hf_scope: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: explicitly opt in; excluded from default high-throughput HF list
reference_type: fitted polynomial compared with projected Heff and native TAPW; see validation_audit.json
basis_description: One selected spin-polarized effective orbital per layer, two layer sectors; 24 plane-wave states; remote spin/orbital effects already projected
k_convention: adapter takes fractional row k and converts k@B; raw physical_model takes Cartesian k; z_Q=(kx-Qx)+i(ky-Qy)
carrier_convention: hole H=-H_e; lowest hole bands correspond to highest valence electron bands
limitations: Single-angle polynomial fit; no joint-angle law.
281 independent real fitted coefficients, not a <=10-parameter continuum model; expanded terms.csv has dependent symmetry-related routes.
Polynomial order 10: do not extrapolate to arbitrary momentum or assume positive continuum ultraviolet stability.
The highest-fidelity source Heff projection and the fitted spectral model are distinct; SOURCE_PROJECTION_REPORT.md acceptance does not certify this spectral fit.
No low-parameter model passed native wavefunction gates; this export is diagnostic only.
The explicit adapter negates the electron-energy matrix to obtain holes; no additional per-k shift is applied.
No interaction/form-factor implementation or HF self-consistency solver is included.
